title: Cumsewogue
summary: Cumsewogue is a Brookhaven placename associated with the high plain south of Port Jefferson. It as a farming district and preserves it as a local name connected with movement across the land.
address_label: Port Jefferson Station / Cumsewogue area, Town of Brookhaven, NY
translation_content:
The form is analyzed as Cumsew-auke and interprets it as a walking place, comparing related Algonquian words for walking and crossing a path. No alternate spelling is listed in the available references.

Why Place Names Matter

“A person can relate to place names no matter their background, identity or age. Place names are constantly around us, used every day.”

— Sarah Bannon, Stories From the Land: Indigenous place names (2022), project-lead quotation, opening section
land_loss_content: Cumsewogue shows how Indigenous placenames continued to shape local geography even when later records described roads, farms, and town administration. Keeping the name visible helps connect present-day Brookhaven places with older language, movement, and land-use memory.
whereintheworld_content: Cumsewogue is associated broadly with the modern Cumsewogue and Port Jefferson Station area south of Port Jefferson. Its historic boundaries have not been established.
